items.title: Chargectl's Homebrew tap moved
items.body: Chargectl now comes from tyldra/tools. Run these in Terminal to keep getting it through Homebrew and remove the old tyldra-org/tools. Chargectl quits during the uninstall; open it again afterwards. Your settings stay.

items.title: Remove the old Homebrew tap
items.body: Chargectl already comes from tyldra/tools, but the old tyldra-org/tools tap is still on this Mac. Run this in Terminal to remove it.
